items.originalTitle: Arvid Lindblad issues apology after Racing Bulls team-mate clash in Baku
items.summaryEn: Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad has publicly apologised to his team-mate Liam Lawson following their collision during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
detailZh: 林布拉德就巴库与小红牛队友相撞事件道歉
小红牛新秀阿尔维德·林布拉德就阿塞拜疆大奖赛中与队友利亚姆·劳森的相撞事件道歉
小红牛一级方程式新秀阿尔维德·林布拉德在阿塞拜疆大奖赛中与队友利亚姆·劳森相撞后，已向其公开道歉。
这位英国车手在巴库城市赛道以第七名完赛，拿到六个积分，但比赛中他与队友劳森的相撞令成绩蒙上阴影。
在威廉姆斯车队的阿尔本撞车引发安全车重启时，林德布拉德比他的队友以及前方哈斯车队的奥康都刹车更晚，而那两辆车都在他的前面。最终他被夹在两辆车之间，并与劳森发生了碰撞。
劳森因此打转，最终以第12名完赛，无缘积分区。赛会干事对此事件进行了审查，认为无需进一步处罚，理由是“林德布拉德可用的空间有限”。
比赛结束后，林德布拉德在社交媒体上承担了这起事故的责任，同时也称赞了车队动力单元的表现。
“今天是一场强势的比赛，非常高兴能以第7名完赛，”他在 Instagram 故事中写道，“这一周并不轻松，我对自己在某些环节的处理感到沮丧。
阿维德·林德布拉德，小红牛（小红牛）；利亚姆·劳森，小红牛（小红牛）
“我们车队整体也一直很挣扎，所以我对我们能够反弹，并在这个艰难的周末里把今天的机会发挥到极致，感到非常高兴。特别要感谢动力单元的伙计们——你们今天给了我一台绝对的火箭引擎。”
“对利亚姆发生的事感到很难受——抱歉了兄弟。很高兴我们仍然能为车队带回一些积分。”
赛后第一时间接受天空体育F1采访时，劳森透露这次碰撞让他的赛车底板破了一个洞。他解释说：“我需要看一下回放，我的意思是，在重新发车时大家都进入一号弯，我从左侧被狠狠撞了一下，底板也被撞出了一个洞。”
“所以我真不知道他当时想要留出多大的空间。我们俩同时进入一号弯的时候，我就是搞不明白。”
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad issues apology after Racing Bulls team-mate clash in Baku
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad apologised to team-mate Liam Lawson after their Azerbaijan Grand Prix collision
Racing Bulls Formula 1 rookie Arvid Lindblad has issued a public apology to his team-mate Liam Lawson following their collision during the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
The British driver secured six points with a seventh-place finish around the Baku City Circuit, but the race was marred when he collided with his team-mate Lawson.

During a safety car restart after Williams' Alex Albon crashed, Lindblad braked later than his team-mate and Haas' Esteban Ocon, who were both ahead of him. He ended up becoming sandwiched between the two cars and making contact with Lawson.

Lawson was sent into a spin and ultimately finished outside the points in 12th. The incident was reviewed by the stewards, who deemed that no further action was necessary because of "the restricted space available to [Lindblad]".
Following the race, Lindblad took to social media to take responsibility for the incident, while also praising the team's power unit performance.
"Strong race today, really happy to bring it home in P7," he wrote on his Instagram story. "It’s not been an easy week, and I’m frustrated with how I handled some of it.
Arvid Lindblad, Racing Bulls, Liam Lawson, Racing Bulls
"We’ve struggled as a team too, so I’m really happy with how we bounced back and maximised today on a difficult weekend. Big shoutout to the PU boys - you gave me an absolute rocketship today.
"Gutted about what happened with Liam - sorry mate. Glad we were still able to bring some points home for the team."

Speaking to Sky Sports F1 immediately after the race, Lawson revealed the collision left a hole in his floor. "I need to watch it, but I mean, we're all coming into Turn 1 on the restart, and I just got smoked from my left, put a hole in my floor as well," he explained.
"So I don't really know what gap he was looking for. In the middle of both of us going into Turn 1, I just don't understand it."

items.originalTitle: Oscar Piastri: Error that cost me F1 Azerbaijan GP podium was "a bit weird"
items.summaryEn: McLaren Formula 1 driver Oscar Piastri described his late-race mistake at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix as "a bit weird" after losing a potential podium finish in Baku.
detailZh: 皮亚斯特里：让我错失F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛领奖台的失误"有点奇怪"
一次大规模锁死让皮亚斯特里失去了在阿塞拜疆登上领奖台的机会，而他自己也说不清楚原因
皮亚斯特里、迈凯伦、伊萨克·哈贾尔、红牛车队
迈凯伦F1车手皮亚斯特里将自己在阿塞拜疆大奖赛末段的失误形容为"有点奇怪"，此前他在巴库丢掉了领奖台位置。
第二次安全车重启后，皮亚斯特里排在第三位，而在第一次重启时被维斯塔潘超越之后，他又受到了红牛车手哈贾尔的施压。
这位澳大利亚车手试图在一号弯内侧防守，结果前轮严重抱死直冲出弯，从第三位跌至第十五位——也就是密集车阵中的倒数第二位。
皮亚斯特里表示：“我需要检查一下，因为像那样瞬间两个前轮同时抱死有点奇怪。我不觉得我做了什么特别出格的操作。显然我在防守时走了和平时不同的线路，所以我不知道是不是压到了路面上的拱顶或者什么，但这对我来说确实非常意外。”
“一旦维斯塔潘跑到前面，我就不可能再反超回去了，但看看我能否守住哈贾尔在身后还是挺有意思的。说实话，那可能也会很艰难。在中性胎上很难判断，因为轮胎抱死造成的平斑相当严重，但我感觉用中性胎的状态远不如用软胎时好。”
“我认为我们本来有可能拿到第四名。不过，说‘我们本来有可能’是一回事，实际最终完赛的位置又是另一回事。”
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；伊萨克·哈贾尔，红牛车队
皮亚斯特里整个赛季都在与2026年规格的F1赛车苦苦抗争，这是众所周知的，但这一次在巴库他的表现超过了队友兰多·诺里斯；这位25岁的车手以第三名追平了他本赛季最好的排位赛成绩，并且本有可能拿下自迈阿密以来的首个领奖台完赛成绩。
“总体来说，我不一定会说自己更适应了，但我能从赛车中榨出更多的圈速，”他解释道。“尤其是在驾驶方式上，我已经能够弄清楚自己需要往哪个方向去努力了。”
“除了比赛中的一段时刻，我感觉这个周末的表现已经更接近我对自己期望的水平了。从这方面来说，这让人振奋得多。只是很明显，目前还没有任何成绩可以展示，这还是挺让人痛苦的。”
那么皮亚斯特里在驾驶方面到底需要往哪个方向改进呢？
“之前的赛车，尤其是在正赛中，你要以99%的状态去驾驶，”他解释道，“你必须稍微照顾一下轮胎，而以99%的状态驾驶是最快的方式。
“开这些赛车，感觉你必须一直保持在101%的状态，一旦达不到，圈速就会大幅流失。这就是为什么我说这个周末并不一定更舒服，但我能更容易地达到那个101%或100%的状态。”
“我感觉这个周末我确实学到了一些有意思的东西，可以带回去继续运用，但这仍然是一个学习的过程。”
detailEn: Oscar Piastri: Error that cost me F1 Azerbaijan GP podium was "a bit weird"
A massive lock-up meant Oscar Piastri lost a potential podium finish in Azerbaijan, and he couldn’t quite explain it
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
McLaren Formula 1 driver Oscar Piastri has labelled his late-race Azerbaijan Grand Prix mistake as “a bit weird”, after losing the podium in Baku.
Piastri was running third following the second safety-car restart and came under pressure from Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar after being overtaken by Max Verstappen at the first restart.
Attempting to defend on the inside in Turn 1, the Australian had an enormous lock-up and went straight on, collapsing from third to 15th – the penultimate position in the bunched-up pack.

“I need to look, because it was a bit weird just locking up both fronts instantly like that,” Piastri commented. “I didn't think I did anything spectacular. Obviously I was on a different line to what I normally would be, defending. So I don't know if I was on a crown in the road or something, but it certainly was a surprise to me.

“Once Max got ahead, I was never going to get back past, but it would have been interesting to see if I could keep Hadjar behind. To be honest, it probably would have been tough. It's hard to tell on the medium because they were pretty heavily flat-spotted, but I didn't feel anywhere near as good on the medium as I did on the soft.
“I think potentially we could have been P4. One thing is saying ‘we could have been’, and one thing is where you actually finish.”
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing

Piastri has notoriously been struggling all season with F1’s 2026-spec machinery, but for once he outperformed team-mate Lando Norris in Baku; the 25-year-old equalled his best qualifying result of the season with third place, and could have taken his first podium finish since Miami.

“In general, I wouldn't necessarily say I've been more comfortable, but I've been able to get more lap time out of the car,” he explained. “I've been able to understand which direction I need to go in with my driving especially.

“Apart from one moment in the race, I feel like it's been a weekend much more at the level I expect from myself. From that side of things, it's been much more encouraging. Just, obviously, it's pretty painful to not have anything to show for it yet.”
So what direction did Piastri need to go in with his driving, exactly?
“The previous cars, especially in the race, you drove at 99%,” he explained. “You had to look after the tyres a little bit, and driving at 99% was the fastest way to drive.

“With these cars, it feels like you have to be at 101% all the time, and as soon as you can't be, then you just haemorrhage lap time. That's why I say it's not necessarily been more comfortable this weekend, but I've been able to get to that 101% or 100% a bit easier.
“I feel like I've definitely learned some interesting things this weekend to take forward, but it's still a learning process.”
